mujer.description: A warm, calm, gentle middle-aged Latin American woman reading the Bible aloud in neutral Latin American Spanish. Soft, soothing, unhurried and reverent, like a loving mother reading scripture at bedtime. Clear diction, natural pauses, never dramatic.

hombre.description: A warm, calm, deep middle-aged Latin American man reading the Bible aloud in neutral Latin American Spanish. Gentle, reassuring and reverent, slow and steady, like a kind pastor reading scripture to his congregation at night. Clear diction, natural pauses, never theatrical.
